name: Shopware 6 Admin API
description: Shopware 6 Admin API for shop operators: search any entity with Shopware criteria, maintain products (texts, SEO fields, stock, prices, property options), categories, Shopping Experiences layouts down to single slots, and the media library with upload from a URL, plus sales channels, promotions and SEO URLs. OAuth2 client credentials from a Shopware integration; generic writes, deletes and bulk sync install switched off.
instructions:
## Shopware 6 Admin API
This connector uses the **Admin API** (`/api`) of a Shopware 6 shop, the API the Shopware Administration itself uses: search and read every entity, maintain products (texts, SEO fields, stock, prices, properties), categories, Shopping Experiences layouts and the media library. For the public storefront API with a sales channel access key, use the separate Shopware 6 Store API connector.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. In the Shopware Administration open **Settings > System > Integrations** and click **Add integration**.
2. Give it a name and either switch on **Administrator** or assign a role with the permissions the AI should have (a role with only read rights keeps every write tool failing with 403).
3. Copy the **Access key ID** into `SHOPWARE_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and the **Secret access key** into `SHOPWARE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`. The secret is shown only once; create a new key in the integration if it is lost.
4. `SHOPWARE_URL` is the shop's address without a path, e.g. `https://shop.example.com`. Do not add `/api` or `/admin`.
5. Install and run `shopware_6_admin_get_version` to check the credentials.

AnythingMCP fetches a short-lived bearer token at the shop's `/api/oauth/token` with the OAuth2 client-credentials grant and renews it on its own.

**Ids** are 32 hex characters without dashes. Find them with the search tools; never guess them.

**Search criteria.** Every search tool takes Shopware's criteria: `term`, `ids`, `filter` (equals, equalsAny, contains, prefix, suffix, range, not, multi), `sort`, `associations` (with nested criteria), `includes`, `limit`, `page` and `total_count_mode`. Pass `includes` (e.g. `{"product": ["id", "productNumber", "name", "stock"]}`) whenever you do not need the full records: a product without includes is large. Filter on related fields with dot paths, e.g. `categories.id`, `properties.id`, `manufacturer.name`.

**Languages.** Texts are translated per language. Reads and writes use the shop's system language unless you pass `language_id`, sent as the `sw-language-id` header: a read then returns that translation (fields not translated are null, the `translated` object shows the fallback), a write changes that translation. List languages with `shopware_6_admin_search_entities` and entity `language`. Create records in the system language first.

**Variants** are products with a `parentId`; they inherit empty fields from the parent. Pass `inheritance: true` to `shopware_6_admin_search_products` or `shopware_6_admin_get_product` to see the inherited values.

**Tools**
- Info: `shopware_6_admin_get_version`.
- Products: `shopware_6_admin_search_products`, `shopware_6_admin_get_product`, `shopware_6_admin_update_product`, `shopware_6_admin_add_product_property`, `shopware_6_admin_remove_product_property`, `shopware_6_admin_create_property_option`.
- Categories: `shopware_6_admin_search_categories`, `shopware_6_admin_create_category`, `shopware_6_admin_update_category`.
- Layouts (Shopping Experiences): `shopware_6_admin_search_cms_pages`, `shopware_6_admin_get_cms_page` (sections, blocks and slots), `shopware_6_admin_create_cms_page`, `shopware_6_admin_update_cms_page`, `shopware_6_admin_create_cms_block`, `shopware_6_admin_update_cms_slot`.
- Media: `shopware_6_admin_search_media`, `shopware_6_admin_create_media` then `shopware_6_admin_upload_media_from_url`, `shopware_6_admin_update_media`, `shopware_6_admin_create_media_folder`. Uploading by URL needs Shopware's `enable_url_upload_feature` (on by default) and a public URL.
- Sales channels, promotions, SEO URLs: `shopware_6_admin_search_sales_channels`, `shopware_6_admin_search_promotions`, `shopware_6_admin_search_seo_urls`.
- Any entity: `shopware_6_admin_search_entities`, `shopware_6_admin_get_entity`, and, installed switched off, `shopware_6_admin_create_entity`, `shopware_6_admin_update_entity`, `shopware_6_admin_delete_entity` and `shopware_6_admin_sync` (bulk upsert and delete).

**Writes change the live shop.** The product, category, layout, slot and media tools change what shoppers see as soon as the shop's cache is refreshed: name the record and the new values, and wait for the user's yes before any write. `shopware_6_admin_remove_product_property` only unlinks an option and is undone with `shopware_6_admin_add_product_property`; `shopware_6_admin_upload_media_from_url` replaces an existing file. The generic writes, deletes and the Sync API are installed switched off: a workspace admin turns them on deliberately.

**Writes answer with an empty 204** when nothing is returned (updates, uploads, deletes); read the record back to confirm. The create tools return the new record with its id.

Docs: https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/integrations-api/ and the Admin API reference at https://shopware.stoplight.io/docs/admin-api.
prerequisites: A Shopware 6 shop and an integration created under Settings > System > Integrations, with the Administrator switch or a role that grants the permissions you need.

SHOPWARE_URL.label: Shop address
SHOPWARE_URL.help: The address of your Shopware 6 shop without a path, e.g. https://shop.example.com. Not /admin, not /api.
SHOPWARE_URL.patternMessage: Only the address, e.g. https://shop.example.com, without /admin or /api.

SHOPWARE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.label: Access key ID
SHOPWARE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.help: Settings > System > Integrations in the Shopware Administration: the Access key ID of the integration. It starts with SWIA.
SHOPWARE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.patternMessage: Paste the integration's Access key ID; it starts with SWIA.

SHOPWARE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.label: Secret access key
SHOPWARE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.help: The Secret access key shown once when the integration (or a new key) is created.
SHOPWARE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the secret access key, without spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: Shopware refused the integration's access key or secret. Copy both again from Settings > System > Integrations, or create a new key there.
verifyHints.403: The credentials work, but the integration's role may not do this. Switch on Administrator for the integration or extend its role.
verifyHints.404: Nothing found at this address. SHOPWARE_URL must be the shop's address only, e.g. https://shop.example.com, without /admin or /api.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_get_version
tools.description: Read the Shopware version of the instance. Costs nothing and checks that the integration credentials work.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_search_products
tools.description: Search products with Shopware criteria: free text, filters (productNumber, active, stock, manufacturerId, categories.id, properties.id, parentId for variants), sort, associations and includes. Returns {total, data, aggregations}. Variants are products too (parentId set); add inheritance to see the values they inherit.

term.description: Free-text search, ranked by Shopware's search ranking.

ids.description: Only these ids (32 hex characters each).

filter.description: Shopware criteria filters, combined with AND, e.g. [{"type":"equals","field":"active","value":true}], [{"type":"contains","field":"name","value":"shirt"}], [{"type":"equalsAny","field":"productNumber","value":["SW1","SW2"]}], {"type":"range","field":"stock","parameters":{"lte":5}}, or {"type":"multi","operator":"or","queries":[...]}.

associations.description: Related entities to load, each with optional nested criteria, e.g. {"properties":{"associations":{"group":{}}},"media":{},"categories":{}}.

includes.description: Return only these fields per entity type (keyed by apiAlias), e.g. {"product":["id","productNumber","name","stock","active"]}. Strongly recommended: full entities are large.

limit.description: Results per page (Shopware's default max is 500).

total_count_mode.description: 0 no total, 1 exact total, 2 only whether a next page exists.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) for translated fields such as name and description, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out for the shop's system language. Find ids with shopware_6_admin_search_entities, entity language.

inheritance.description: Pass true to fill a variant's empty fields from its parent product (sw-inheritance header). Leave out otherwise: Shopware switches inheritance on whenever the header is present.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_get_product
tools.description: Read one product by id with its own fields (name, productNumber, stock, price, active, description, SEO fields, customFields). For related data (properties, media, categories, variants) use shopware_6_admin_search_products with ids and associations.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) for translated fields such as name and description, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out for the shop's system language. Find ids with shopware_6_admin_search_entities, entity language.

inheritance.description: Pass true to fill a variant's empty fields from its parent product (sw-inheritance header). Leave out otherwise: Shopware switches inheritance on whenever the header is present.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_update_product
tools.description: Change fields of one product in the live shop: texts and SEO fields (written in the language of language_id), custom fields, active flag, stock, closeout, EAN or price. Only the fields you pass change. customFields are merged key by key; price replaces the whole price list.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by technical name, e.g. {"my_field": "value"}.

is_closeout.description: Closeout: not orderable when out of stock.

price.description: Full price list, e.g. [{"currencyId":"<currency id>","gross":19.99,"net":16.8,"linked":true}]. Replaces the existing prices.

fields.description: Any further product fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) whose translation this write changes, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out to write the system language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_add_product_property
tools.description: Assign an existing property option (e.g. Color: Red) to a product. The option keeps existing; this only links it. Find option ids with shopware_6_admin_search_entities, entity property-group-option.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_remove_product_property
tools.description: Unassign a property option from a product. Only the link is removed; the option itself and its other products stay. Undo with shopware_6_admin_add_product_property.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_property_option
tools.description: Create a new option in a property group (e.g. a new color value). Returns the new option with its id, ready for shopware_6_admin_add_product_property. Find group ids with shopware_6_admin_search_entities, entity property-group.

name.description: Option name in the system language.

fields.description: Any further property option (e.g. colorHexCode, mediaId) fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_search_categories
tools.description: Search categories with Shopware criteria, e.g. filter parentId for the children of a category, or level / active. Each category carries parentId, afterCategoryId (its left sibling), type, cmsPageId, active, visible and the breadcrumb.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_category
tools.description: Create a category in the live catalog tree: a page, a folder (structure only) or a link. Returns the new category with its id.

name.description: Category name in the system language.

parent_id.description: Parent category id. Leave out only for a new root category.

after_category_id.description: Id of the sibling this category is placed after. Leave out to place it first.

visible.description: Whether it shows in the navigation.

cms_page_id.description: Layout (CMS page) id for a page category.

link_type.description: For a link category: what it points to.

internal_link.description: Target id for link_type category, product or landing_page.

link_new_tab.description: Open the link in a new tab.

fields.description: Any further category fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_update_category
tools.description: Change one category in the live shop: name, texts and SEO fields (in the language of language_id), active / visible, layout, or its place in the tree (parent_id, after_category_id). Only the fields you pass change.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by technical name.

visible.description: Whether it shows in the navigation.

parent_id.description: New parent category id (moves the category).

after_category_id.description: Id of the sibling it is placed after.

fields.description: Any further category fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) whose translation this write changes, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out to write the system language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_search_cms_pages
tools.description: Search Shopping Experiences layouts (CMS pages) with Shopware criteria, e.g. filter type landingpage / page / product_list / product_detail, or term on the name. For one layout with its sections, blocks and slots use shopware_6_admin_get_cms_page.

ids.description: Only these ids (32 hex characters each).

filter.description: Shopware criteria filters, combined with AND, e.g. [{"type":"equals","field":"active","value":true}], [{"type":"contains","field":"name","value":"shirt"}], [{"type":"equalsAny","field":"productNumber","value":["SW1","SW2"]}], {"type":"range","field":"stock","parameters":{"lte":5}}, or {"type":"multi","operator":"or","queries":[...]}.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_get_cms_page
tools.description: Read one layout (CMS page) with its sections, blocks and slots sorted by position, including each slot's id, type and config (texts, media ids). Use the slot ids with shopware_6_admin_update_cms_slot.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) for translated fields such as name and description, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out for the shop's system language. Find ids with shopware_6_admin_search_entities, entity language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_cms_page
tools.description: Create a layout (CMS page), optionally with its sections, blocks and slots nested in one call. Returns the new page with its id. Assign it to a category with shopware_6_admin_update_category (cms_page_id).

type.description: Layout type: page (shop page), landingpage, product_list (category listing) or product_detail.

fields.description: Any further CMS page (e.g. cssClass, previewMediaId) fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_update_cms_page
tools.description: Change a layout in the live shop: rename it, or update and add sections with their blocks and slots. Sections, blocks and slots that carry an existing id are updated, those without an id are added; nothing is removed.

sections.description: Sections to update (with id) or add (without id), with nested blocks and slots as in shopware_6_admin_create_cms_page.

fields.description: Any further CMS page fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) whose translation this write changes, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out to write the system language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_cms_block
tools.description: Add a block (e.g. text, image, image-text, product-listing) with its slots to an existing section of a layout. Returns the new block with its id.

type.description: Block type, e.g. text, image, image-text, text-two-column, product-listing.

fields.description: Any further CMS block (e.g. marginTop, backgroundColor, cssClass, visibility) fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_update_cms_slot
tools.description: Change the content of one slot in the live shop, e.g. the HTML of a text element or the media of an image element, in the language of language_id. config replaces the slot's config for that language, so send every config key the element needs.

config.description:
Slot config, e.g. {"content":{"source":"static","value":"

New text

"},"verticalAlign":{"source":"static","value":null}} for a text slot or {"media":{"source":"static","value":""}} for an image slot.

fields.description: Any further CMS slot (e.g. type, locked) fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) whose translation this write changes, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out to write the system language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_search_media
tools.description: Search the media library with Shopware criteria, e.g. filter mediaFolderId, fileName, mimeType, or term. Each item carries url, fileName, fileExtension, alt, title and mediaFolderId.

term.description: Free-text search, ranked by Shopware's search ranking.

ids.description: Only these ids (32 hex characters each).

filter.description: Shopware criteria filters, combined with AND, e.g. [{"type":"equals","field":"active","value":true}], [{"type":"contains","field":"name","value":"shirt"}], [{"type":"equalsAny","field":"productNumber","value":["SW1","SW2"]}], {"type":"range","field":"stock","parameters":{"lte":5}}, or {"type":"multi","operator":"or","queries":[...]}.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_media
tools.description: Create an empty media entry (no file yet) in the media library, optionally in a folder. Returns its id; then load the file with shopware_6_admin_upload_media_from_url.

media_folder_id.description: Media folder id. Find folders with shopware_6_admin_search_entities, entity media-folder.

fields.description: Any further media (e.g. private, customFields) fields in Shopware's camelCase names, merged into the request body; the named parameters above win on conflicts.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_upload_media_from_url
tools.description: Have Shopware download a file from a public URL into a media entry (created with shopware_6_admin_create_media). If the entry already has a file, it is replaced. Answers 204 with no body on success.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file. Shopware fetches it itself; private network addresses are refused.

extension.description: File extension without the dot, e.g. jpg, png, webp, pdf.

file_name.description: File name without extension; must be unique in the media library. Defaults to the media id.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_update_media
tools.description: Change the alt text, title, folder or custom fields of a media entry in the live shop (alt and title in the language of language_id).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by technical name.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) whose translation this write changes, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out to write the system language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_media_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the media library. A folder needs a configuration: either inherit the parent's (use_parent_configuration true plus configuration_id = the parent's configurationId) or pass configuration {} for a new default one. Returns the new folder with its id.

parent_id.description: Parent folder id. Leave out for a top-level folder.

use_parent_configuration.description: Inherit thumbnail settings from the parent folder.

configuration_id.description: Existing media folder configuration id, e.g. the parent folder's configurationId.

configuration.description: New configuration, e.g. {} for defaults or {"createThumbnails":true,"keepAspectRatio":true}.

Returns {total, data, aggregations}. Typed search tools exist for products, categories, layouts, media, sales channels, promotions and SEO URLs.

tools.description: Read one record of any Admin API entity by id, e.g. order, customer, category, cms-slot, media, promotion. Returns {data} with the record's own fields; for related data use shopware_6_admin_search_entities with ids and associations.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_create_entity
tools.description: Create one record of any Admin API entity, e.g. a cms-section, snippet, product-manufacturer or a product. Writes to the live shop. Returns the new record. For many records at once use shopware_6_admin_sync.

entity.description: Entity name in kebab case, e.g. product-manufacturer, cms-section, snippet.

data.description: The record in Shopware's camelCase field names, e.g. {"name":"ACME","link":"https://acme.example"} for a product-manufacturer. Associations can be nested.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_update_entity
tools.description: Change fields of one record of any Admin API entity in the live shop (orders, customers, sales channels, settings included). Only the fields you pass change. Translated fields are written in the language of language_id.

entity.description: Entity name in kebab case, e.g. sales-channel, promotion, snippet.

data.description: Fields to change, in Shopware's camelCase names.

language_id.description: Language id (32 hex characters) whose translation this write changes, sent as the sw-language-id header. Leave out to write the system language.

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_delete_entity
tools.description: Delete one record of any Admin API entity by id, e.g. a cms-block, a product or a media entry. Permanent; dependent records may be deleted with it (cascade).

tools.name: shopware_6_admin_sync
tools.description: Bulk write: upsert or delete many records of one or more entities in a single request through the Sync API. Upserts create records without id and overwrite those with an existing id; deletes are permanent.

operations.description: List of operations, e.g. [{"action":"upsert","entity":"product","payload":[{"id":"<id>","stock":10},{"id":"<id2>","stock":0}]},{"action":"delete","entity":"product_property","payload":[{"productId":"<id>","optionId":"<optionId>"}]}]. Entity names use snake case here (product_property, product_category).

fail_on_error.description: false continues with the next operations after an error (fail-on-error header). Default true: the whole request is rolled back.

indexing_behavior.description: indexing-behavior header: use-queue-indexing defers indexing to the message queue (faster for big batches); disable-indexing skips it (run indexing afterwards). Default: index synchronously.
